6.316 rsLookupInFilterExpression
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsLookupInFilterExpression is a critical error that will occur when a Lookup, LookupSet, or MultiLookup
function is present within a Filter.FilterExpression element inside of a DataSet.Filters element.
